$description: Typography roles. Each family names its face (loaded by next/font in app/layout.tsx, whose arguments must be literals) and the CSS variable next/font sets; the build emits --font-<role> in @theme inline as that variable followed by the fallbacks, and the generated FONT_VARIABLES constant is what a test holds layout.tsx to. The wordmark is how the brand name is set inside running text: the logo's own face, weight, case and tracking.

brand.$description: The logo's typeface (web_client/brand/fonts, the wordmark of the master logo): the brand name only.

wordmark.$description: The brand name inside a sentence or heading (utility `wordmark`). Measured on the master logo by scripts/brand/construct-mark.py: BIOEDILIZIA is Red Hat Display 400 in capitals, tracked 121.68 units per 1000 so its ink spans the symbol's width.
